key_takeaways: A good anniversary trip package puts the room category, the view, the private dinner and the terms in writing before you pay.
A catalogue bundle suits a short, simple stay; a tailored package suits a long-haul milestone with moving parts.
Booking through an advisor does not add legal rights; the value is one accountable contact and terms read before you commit.
Check passports and entry rules, insurance cover for every country and activity, and change terms before you book.
For a parent's 50th, apply for a Governor-General message no later than two months before the date.

faq.q: What is the best anniversary trip for a couple?
faq.a: The one built around how you two like to spend time together, not around a hotel's preset menu. Start with the feeling you want on the night itself (quiet, celebratory or adventurous), then choose the place and the pace to suit. A trip that knows it is your anniversary beats a grander one that does not.

faq.q: Where can we go for an anniversary from Australia?
faq.a: Start with how many nights you have. A long weekend suits somewhere close, so you are not spending the anniversary in transit. A week or more opens long-haul options in Europe, where an extra night either side of the flight gives you time to settle before the date that matters.

faq.q: How far ahead should we book an anniversary trip package?
faq.a: Our packages page suggests three to six months ahead for most trips, and earlier for July to October in Europe and Africa and anywhere over Christmas. If the trip includes a vow renewal or brings family along, start sooner.

faq.q: Is a travel advisor worth it for a short anniversary trip?
faq.a: For a single hotel and a short stay, it can still be worth a call. Our travel page says a straightforward hotel booking usually carries no planning fee, while complex itineraries, flights or group work may carry a fee agreed upfront. The first conversation takes about 15 minutes, with no obligation and no cost to ask.

faq.q: Can we renew our vows on an anniversary trip?
faq.a: Yes. Our Vow renewals tile puts it this way: "We arrange the setting, the photographer, the flowers and the dinner after." Decide early who you want there, since that shapes the venue and the rooms, and read about who hosts, who speaks and what to wear at a vow renewal.
